title: McpSee
description: The see tool (decision 0156, VP-3): a small picture of what the body sees from its eyes, as a PNG with a fixed caption.

SeeInput.description: A picture of what your body sees from its eyes, drawn as a small image. No arguments, or an optional width and height in pixels; the picture is drawn at most 640 by 360, and a larger size is brought down to that. Pictures are limited to one every 5 seconds and 30 an hour.

SeeResult.description: The picture: a base64 PNG and its caption. The MCP layer sends the picture as an image content block and the caption as a text block.
